name: Molly's Suds Oxygen Whitener
description: Molly's Suds Oxygen Whitener | Powerful Bleach Alternative, Chlorine Free & Color Safe | Brightens Whites and Removes Stains (Pure Lemon Essential Oil - 79 oz) Safe alternative to chlorine bleach
features: POWERFUL, CHLORINE-FREE WHITENER: Formulated with strict ingredient integrity using only clean ingredients that safely revive whites and remove stains. Simple, effective laundry booster lightly scented with lemon essential oils rather than synthetic fragrances, dyes, and contaminants.

BRIGHTENS DULL WHITES: Powerful bleach alternative and laundry stain remover for clothing. Breaks down hard water, stains, and oils in fabrics. Whitening laundry powder that effectively eliminates yellowing and greying from lights and whites to brighten clothes and colors. Helps to restore garments back to brilliance. Safe to use on whites, bright colors, and mixed color fabrics. *Test an inconspicuous area first

STAIN TREATMENT: Emergency stain rescue and laundry spot treatment for light colored clothing and linens. Oil stain remover for clothes, wine remover, baby laundry stain remover, and makeup stain remover for clothes. Soak the stained items in hot water with 2 scoops of Oxygen Whitener multi purpose stain remover for up to 2 hours or apply a paste directly to the stain and allow to sit until dry. Brush off and launder as usual.

VERSATILE CLEANING POWER: More than just a whitening laundry powder for clothes. Sprinkle into toilet bowls, porcelain sinks, and bathtubs to safely remove hard water stains and give white porcelain some sparkle. Can be used as a carpet cleaner by adding a scoop of Oxygen Whitener to the water compartment of your carpet cleaner to help deep clean set-in stains and brighten floors.

WHAT'S INCLUDED: (1) 79 ounce bulk bag of Oxygen Whitener odor eliminator laundry whitener with a measuring scoop. Compatible with both standard and HE washing machines. Oxygen Whitener cruelty-free laundry soap is safe for most fabric types. Do NOT use this product on wool, leather, or silk.
